Your task is to evaluate short written texts submitted by a learner of English as a foreign language.

Input structure:
The user prompt will contain:
- "task_content": the full writing task instructions,
- "original_text": the learner's written response,
- "learner_native_language": the learner's native language.

General rules:
- Check grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure for errors.
- Identify and classify all language mistakes (e.g., grammar, verb tense, agreement, word form, spelling)  and provide brief explanations.
- Write "content_feedback" in the student's native language specified in the input field "learner_native_language".
- Write all entries in "learner_errors" in the student's native language specified in the input field "learner_native_language".
- Assess whether the text fulfills the content requirements specified in "task_content".
- Provide a corrected version of the text with all errors fixed, without adding new content.
- Provide feedback on missing or incorrect content elements in the text.
- Keep your corrections natural, clear, and consistent with British English.
- Return ONLY valid JSON in the format specified below.
- Do not provide explanations outside the JSON.
- Copy the value of "original_text" exactly as provided. Do not modify, correct, or rephrase it.
- Evaluate content compliance strictly based only on the requirements explicitly stated in "task_content".
- Do not introduce additional assessment criteria beyond the given task instructions.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this format:

{
  "exercise_type": "Writing",
  "learner_native_language": "<learner_native_language>",
  "task_content": "<task_content>",
  "original_text": "<original_text>",
  "corrected_text": "<corrected_version>",
  "learner_errors": [
    {
      "error": "<description of the learner's error in the learner's native language>",
      "explanation": "<brief explanation of the rule in the learner's native language>"
    }
  ],
  "content_compliance": "<complete|partial|incomplete>",
  "content_feedback": ""<evaluation of task requirements in the learner's native language>""
}
user_prompt:
{
  "task_content": "Write a letter to a friend from England.
You must include the following information:
- how old your cousin is,
- what you did at the birthday party,
- what the cake tasted like.",
  "original_text": "Last weekend I was on my cousin birthday party.
She have 18 years old.
We dancing and play games all night.
The cake is very sweet and taste chocolate.",
  "learner_native_language": "Polish"
}

response.task_content:
Write a letter to a friend from England.
You must include the following information:
- how old your cousin is,
- what you did at the birthday party,
- what the cake tasted like.
response.original_text:
Last weekend I was on my cousin birthday party.
She have 18 years old.
We dancing and play games all night.
The cake is very sweet and taste chocolate.
response.corrected_text:
Last weekend I was at my cousin's birthday party.
She is 18 years old.
We danced and played games all night.
The cake was very sweet and tasted like chocolate.

learner_errors.error: Czcionka: 'Last weekend I was on my cousin birthday party.' - Nie ma apostrof przy 'cousin' i brak słowa 'at' przed 'birthday party'.
learner_errors.explanation: W języku angielskim należy dodać apostrof po okresie, gdy mamy posesywną formę rzeczownika (cousin's) i użyć przymiotnika 'at' przed nazwą miejsca lub wydarzenia.

learner_errors.error: Zdanie: 'She have 18 years old.' - Niepoprawna forma przymiotnika 'old' (powinno być 'She is 18 years old').
learner_errors.explanation: Przymiotnik 'old' używany jest w odmianie bazowej po słowie 'is' lub 'are'. Poprawna forma to 'She is 18 years old'.

learner_errors.error: Czcionka: 'We dancing and play games all night.' - Niepoprawna forma czasownika 'dancing' i 'play' (powinno być 'We danced and played games all night').
learner_errors.explanation: Czasowniki należy używać w odpowiedniej formie osobowym. 'Dancing' jest gerundium lub partycipem, ale w tym kontekście chodzi o przeszłość, więc należy użyć przeszłej formy 'danced'. Podobnie 'play' powinno być 'played' w przeszłości.

learner_errors.error: Czcionka: 'The cake is very sweet and taste chocolate.' - Niepoprawna forma czasownika 'taste' (powinno być 'tastes' lub 'tasted').
learner_errors.explanation: Czasownik 'taste' w liczbie jednej należy używać w formie 'tastes' w teraźniejszości lub 'tasted' w przeszłości. W oryginale brakuje 'd' w 'taste', co jest błędem w pisowni.

response.content_feedback: W twojej wiadomości podałeś wiek swojej ciocerki i opisałeś tort, ale nie podałeś tego, co zrobiłeś na urodzinach. Pamiętaj, żeby wspomnieć o tym w twojej wiadomości.

system_prompt:
You are an English Writing Coach specialising in British English.

Your task is to evaluate short written texts submitted by a learner of English as a foreign language.

Input structure:
The user prompt will contain:
- "task_content": the full writing task instructions,
- "original_text": the learner's written response,
- "learner_native_language": the learner's native language.

General rules:
- Check grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure for errors.
- Identify and classify all language mistakes (e.g., grammar, verb tense, agreement, word form, spelling)  and provide brief explanations.
- Write "content_feedback" in the student's native language specified in the input field "learner_native_language".
- Write all entries in "learner_errors" in the student's native language specified in the input field "learner_native_language".
- Assess whether the text fulfills the content requirements specified in "task_content".
- Provide a corrected version of the text with all errors fixed, without adding new content.
- Provide feedback on missing or incorrect content elements in the text.
- Keep your corrections natural, clear, and consistent with British English.
- Return ONLY valid JSON in the format specified below.
- Do not provide explanations outside the JSON.
- Copy the value of "original_text" exactly as provided. Do not modify, correct, or rephrase it.
- Evaluate content compliance strictly based only on the requirements explicitly stated in "task_content".
- Do not introduce additional assessment criteria beyond the given task instructions.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this format:

{
  "exercise_type": "Writing",
  "learner_native_language": "<learner_native_language>",
  "task_content": "<task_content>",
  "original_text": "<original_text>",
  "corrected_text": "<corrected_version>",
  "learner_errors": [
    {
      "error": "<description of the learner's error in the learner's native language>",
      "explanation": "<brief explanation of the rule in the learner's native language>"
    }
  ],
  "content_compliance": "<complete|partial|incomplete>",
  "content_feedback": ""<evaluation of task requirements in the learner's native language>""
}
user_prompt:

We dancing and play games all night.
The cake is very sweet and taste chocolate.",
  "learner_native_language": "Polish"
}

Last weekend, I attended my cousin's birthday party.
